data.headline: Deposits grew, but noninterest-bearing mix fell as brokered funding jumped

claims.text: Total deposits increased 6.2% quarter over quarter to $2.01 billion at June 30, 2026.
Noninterest-bearing deposits fell to 22.7% of total deposits, down 2.6 percentage points quarter over quarter.
Brokered deposits rose to 14.2% of total deposits, up 10.6 percentage points quarter over quarter.
The 10-Q says the increase in brokered deposits was primarily to fund loan growth and the acquisition of Targeted Lending.

citation.quote: The increase in brokered deposits was primarily to fund loan growth and the acquisition of Targeted Lending.

claims.text: The 10-Q attributes the increase in the average cost of interest-bearing deposits to a shift toward higher-cost interest-bearing accounts.

citation.quote: The increase in the average cost of interest-bearing deposits was primarily due to a shift in the mix of deposits towards higher cost interest-bearing deposit accounts.
